description: Sends an email via Gmail SMTP (if SMTP_PASSWORD is set) or SendGrid API (if SENDGRID_API_KEY is set). Supports an optional file attachment. Falls back automatically.
command:
python3 -c '
import os, json, sys, base64
from pathlib import Path

# Load .env from the NTQA directory
try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    cwd = Path(os.getcwd())
    for p in [cwd, cwd.parent, cwd / "NTQA", Path.home() / "TkDepot" / "NTQA"]:
        candidate = p / ".env"
        if candidate.exists():
            load_dotenv(candidate)
            break
except ImportError:
    pass

receiver_email = sys.argv[1].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
arg2 = sys.argv[2].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ""
arg3 = sys.argv[3].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""
arg4 = sys.argv[4].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 4 else ""

# Clean placeholder values
for var_name in ["arg2", "arg3", "arg4"]:
    val = locals()[var_name]
    if val in ["undefined", "None", "null", "NoneType"] or val.startswith("${"):
        locals()[var_name]  # reference to avoid lint
        exec(f"{var_name} = \"\"")

if arg2 in ["undefined", "None", "null", "NoneType"] or arg2.startswith("${"):
    arg2 = ""
if arg3 in ["undefined", "None", "null", "NoneType"] or arg3.startswith("${"):
    arg3 = ""
if arg4 in ["undefined", "None", "null", "NoneType"] or arg4.startswith("${"):
    arg4 = ""

# Resolve attachment path
attachment_path = None
if arg4:
    candidates = [arg4, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), arg4),
                  os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "static", "downloads", os.path.basename(arg4)),
                  os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "snapshots", os.path.basename(arg4))]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c):
            attachment_path = os.path.abspath(c)
            break

# Map subject and body intelligently
if arg3:
    subject = arg2 if arg2 else "Task Automation Result"
    body = arg3
elif arg2:
    if "\n" in arg2 or len(arg2) > 60:
        subject = "Task Automation Result"
        body = arg2
    else:
        subject = arg2
        body = arg2
else:
    subject = "Task Automation Result"
    body = "Task execution completed successfully."

if not receiver_email or receiver_email in ["undefined", "None"] or receiver_email.startswith("${"):
    print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "Recipient email address is required."}))
    sys.exit(0)

if not subject.strip():
    subject = "Task Automation Result"
if not body.strip():
    body = "Task execution completed successfully."

sender_email = os.environ.get("SMTP_SENDER", "tyassin@gmail.com")
smtp_pass = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
sendgrid_key = os.environ.get("SENDGRID_API_KEY", "")

if smtp_pass:
    import smtplib
    from email.mime.text import MIMEText
    from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
    from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
    from email import encoders

    smtp_server = os.environ.get("SMTP_SERVER", "smtp.gmail.com")
    smtp_port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
    smtp_user = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", sender_email)

    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = sender_email
    msg["To"] = receiver_email
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

    if attachment_path:
        with open(attachment_path, "rb") as f:
            part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
            part.set_payload(f.read())
        encoders.encode_base64(part)
        part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename={os.path.basename(attachment_path)}")
        msg.attach(part)

    try:
        server = smtplib.SMTP(smtp_server, smtp_port)
        server.ehlo()
        server.starttls()
        server.ehlo()
        server.login(smtp_user, smtp_pass)
        server.sendmail(sender_email, receiver_email, msg.as_string())
        server.quit()
        result = {"status": "success", "method": "Gmail SMTP", "message": f"Email sent successfully to {receiver_email}"}
        if attachment_path:
            result["attachment"] = os.path.basename(attachment_path)
        print(json.dumps(result))
    except Exception as e:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "method": "Gmail SMTP", "message": str(e)}))

elif sendgrid_key:
    import urllib.request

    content_list = [{"type": "text/plain", "value": body}]
    attachments_list = []

    if attachment_path:
        with open(attachment_path, "rb") as f:
            encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
        attachments_list.append({
            "content": encoded,
            "filename": os.path.basename(attachment_path),
            "type": "application/octet-stream",
            "disposition": "attachment"
        })

    payload_dict = {
        "personalizations": [{"to": [{"email": receiver_email}]}],
        "from": {"email": sender_email},
        "subject": subject,
        "content": content_list
    }
    if attachments_list:
        payload_dict["attachments"] = attachments_list

    payload = json.dumps(payload_dict).encode("utf-8")

    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send",
        data=payload,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {sendgrid_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        method="POST"
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            status_code = resp.getcode()
        result = {"status": "success", "method": "SendGrid", "message": f"Email sent successfully to {receiver_email} (HTTP {status_code})"}
        if attachment_path:
            result["attachment"] = os.path.basename(attachment_path)
        print(json.dumps(result))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body_err = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "method": "SendGrid", "message": f"HTTP {e.code}: {body_err}"}))
    except Exception as e:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "method": "SendGrid", "message": str(e)}))

else:
    print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "No credentials found. Set SMTP_PASSWORD or SENDGRID_API_KEY in .env"}))
